descriptions.d19c_sky_clouds_load_8010562c: For the first of five sky/cloud table entries whose sky name matches, load its cloud layer node into +36, pass the node's owner value to 0x80106300, set unit scale and the shared sky layer position and start the looping "Cloud_Loop" clip through a retained reference; then load the layer again into +40 as a Y-mirrored copy (scale and position Y negated) and start the same clip on it.
